newsitem.title: GERMANY: Franco-German news conference probably delayed.
newsitem.headline: Franco-German news conference probably delayed.

text.p: A news conference originally scheduled to take place at 1130 GMT after a Franco-German economic summit meeting here is likely to be delayed, a German finance ministry official said.
"We probably won't make (that time)," the official said.

The anticipated delay was due to foggy weather, which prevented German and French officials from arriving in the Bavarian town of Kempten on time. They were forced to find an impromptu meeting place in the Stuttgart airport VIP lounge.

The talks between German Finance Minister Theo Waigel, Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer, French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis and Bank of France President Jean-Claude Trichet were expected to be moved to Kempten at about 0900 GMT.
